Terms of Use

Effective 1 November 2026 (2026-11-01)

These terms cover your use of Winkaboo, the camera app made by CyberFruit Lab - FZCO, a free zone company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (“we”, “us”). By downloading or using Winkaboo you agree to them. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the app. How we handle your data is in the Privacy Policy.

1. The free tier

Winkaboo is free to use with 5 shots a day. We may improve or change the app over time.

2. Winkaboo Unlimited

Winkaboo Unlimited is an optional auto-renewing subscription that gives you unlimited shots, with no daily limit. It comes in two plans:

  • Yearly: $39.99 a year in the US, with a 3-day free trial.
  • Weekly: $4.99 a week in the US.

The App Store shows your local price, which may differ by country and may include local taxes, in the app before you buy.

3. Free trial

The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial. The trial converts to a paid yearly subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. If you cancel in time you are not charged.

4. Payment, renewal and cancellation

  • Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (or, with a free trial, when the trial ends).
  • Subscriptions renew automatically at the price of your plan unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
  • You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings › your name › Subscriptions on your iPhone. Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep Winkaboo Unlimited until the end of the period you have already paid for.
  • Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

5. Refunds

Purchases are made through Apple, so refunds — including any right you have by law to withdraw from a purchase within 14 days — are handled by Apple under its terms. You can ask for one at reportaproblem.apple.com or through Apple Support. We can’t issue refunds ourselves.

6. Acceptable use

Use Winkaboo lawfully and with respect for other people. Please don’t:

  • photograph or film people in a way that breaks the law or their privacy;
  • copy, reverse-engineer or tamper with the app, or work around its limits or its subscription.

Please also look up from the screen: stay aware of your surroundings while you shoot.

7. Your photos belong to you

The photos, videos and reels you make with Winkaboo are yours. We don’t claim any ownership of them. They stay on your phone unless you save them to Photos or share them yourself; the Privacy Policy explains where everything is kept.

Unless you are a consumer in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Switzerland or Japan: Winkaboo is provided “as is” and “as available” and, to the extent the law allows, we disclaim all implied warranties, including of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We don’t promise that it will be uninterrupted or error-free, that it will catch every moment, or that it will pick the frame you would have picked. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, loss of profits or data, or losses caused by events outside our reasonable control; and our total liability to you for all claims relating to Winkaboo is limited to the greater of what you paid for Winkaboo Unlimited in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim, and 50 US dollars.

If you are a consumer in the United Kingdom: we are responsible for loss or damage you suffer that is a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care and skill, but not for loss or damage that was not foreseeable, or for loss of profit, business or opportunity.

If you are a consumer in the European Economic Area, Switzerland or Japan, we are liable as the law of the country where you live provides. 9. Apple’s Standard EULA

Winkaboo is licensed to you under Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement. These terms add to that agreement; where they conflict on the app licence itself, Apple’s agreement applies.

10. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The effective date at the top shows when they last changed. We will tell you in the app or on this site at least 30 days before a change that materially affects you takes effect; if you don’t agree, you can stop using Winkaboo and cancel your subscription.

11. Governing law

These terms, and any dispute or claim (including a non-contractual one) arising out of or in connection with them or Winkaboo, are governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), and the DIFC Courts have exclusive jurisdiction. If you are a consumer, this does not take away the protection of the laws of the country where you live that cannot be excluded by agreement, or apply where those laws require their own law to govern these terms, and you may also bring proceedings in the courts where you live wherever those laws give you that right. Before going to court, please write to us at hi@cyberfruit.ai so we can try to put things right. For the app licence itself, Apple’s Standard EULA sets its own law and courts.

12. Contact
